text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Aah—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I can clearly feel the breeze caressing me...
The world looks so, so beautiful...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... did itâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(So this is what it feels like...
to run all the way through a GⅠ race...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I did it... I really ran in a GⅠ...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(With this, I really might...
Even make it to the Triple Tiara...!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Your running was so stunning I was completely entranced!
Nice fight! Great guts!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl-san—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Being able to compete with you, Pearl-san...
well... it gave me confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~... Emotion!!!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whether our paths will cross again,
only God knows, but...
let me just say this.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—O infinite potential,
bestow great radiance upon our future!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Mejiro Dober.
Until we meet again... see you again—

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...!
Mejiro Dober-chan is super cool...!!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text: Could this be the birth of a new star in the Mejiro family...?! Looking forward to seeing her shine on the Tiara route!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Truly marvelous~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober returned with the cheers at her back.
Her face is overflowing with a sense of accomplishment...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I told you, didn't I?
I wanted to get results today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I promised I'd bring home results, after all.
I wonder if... I proved true to my word."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
With this, I'm sure I can... put up a fight, right?
choice_data_list: We're definitely winning the next Oka Sho!
Let's definitely win the next Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
With this, I'm sure I can... put up a fight, right?
choice_data_list: We're definitely winning the next Oka Sho!
Let's definitely win the next Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Of course I will. I made a promise to Bright.
I absolutely have to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I made a promise with Bright...
I'll definitely win, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...And for that very reason... um—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer,
starting tomorrow as well—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you again... starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I've gained solid confidence heading
into the Triple Tiara...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
